summary: The blocking finding is valid and should be repaired by requiring guidance to avoid status-derived phase names that are not accepted metric phases.

items.title: Status-derived phases are not all valid metric phases
items.rationale: The current spec can be satisfied by changing only the `draft` example while leaving text that tells users to use status/next-action phases such as `plan` or `finalize`, which are rejected by `flow set metric`.
items.evidence: `src/lib/constants.js` includes `draft` but not `plan` or `finalize` in `VALID_PHASES`; spec.json requirement R1 and acceptance criteria do not yet require removing or mapping status-derived phase names.
